question: Which project by Ministry of IT won the Gold Award for using new technologies to help citizens at the 22ⁿd National Awards for e-Governance 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhashini Project**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Bhashini Project**, also known as the **National Language Translation Mission**, is a flagship initiative of the **Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)** designed to provide **Artificial Intelligence (AI)**-led language translation services.
 
• It was honored with the **Gold Award** at the **National Awards for e-Governance** under the category of "Application of Emerging Technologies for Providing Citizen Centric Services" for its revolutionary impact on digital accessibility.
 
• The project aims to empower **Indian citizens** by enabling them to access the internet and digital government services in their own **native languages**, thereby bridging the **digital divide**.
 
• It leverages advanced technologies such as **Natural Language Processing (NLP)**, **Machine Learning (ML)**, and **Artificial Intelligence** to provide real-time translation and voice-to-text services for the **22 scheduled languages** of India.
